description.text:
Thunder (雷) is one of the two booster packs of Sword & Shield: Dynamax Clash (极巨争锋), which moved the Simplified Chinese game on to the Sword & Shield series on 19 May 2023, alongside Flame (焰), a V starter deck and a deck building gift box. It brought Pokémon V and Pokémon VMAX to the game, with a new Triple Rare (RRR) rarity for VMAX cards with a special surface finish and a new textured finish for Double Rare (RR) cards. Shiny (S) and shiny full-art (SSR) cards, last seen in Storming Emergence, came back, and Supporters appeared as rainbow (HR) cards for the first time. Packs held 5 or 25 cards.

Thunder holds the Water, Lightning, Psychic and Fighting Pokémon and the Trainers that go with them, with Gigantamax Pikachu on its cover: Pikachu V and Pikachu VMAX are in it. Its other VMAX cards include Inteleon, Lapras, Toxtricity, Gardevoir, Morpeko, Stonjourner and Snorlax VMAX, and its rainbow Supporters are Bede, Marnie, Boss's Orders and Team Yell Grunt. Its main cards are numbered out of 135; shiny, full-art, shiny full-art, rainbow and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 217.
